dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region to the posterior peduncle tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical protrusion on the right lateral margin near the mid-section; complementary shallow indentation on the left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature off-white to light-grey; high-value median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transition between slightly darker cranial tones and the lighter dorsal canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, low-contrast linear markings on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear rake marks on the posterior dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast circular blowhole on the anterior dorsal midline.
